notes: Manufacturer spec sheet lists only a power-IN connector (Neutrik powerCON TRUE1) with an included powerCON TRUE1 power cord — no power-out/link connector is documented, so this fixture is not daisy-chainable for power. DMX/RDM is described as "Locking 3-pin & 5-pin XLR" in/out; Robe fixtures of this generation have separate parallel 3-pin and 5-pin locking XLR sockets (not a single combo jack), so this is modeled as four distinct DMX ports (5-pin/3-pin, in/out) rather than one connector with an accepts[] list. Ethernet (RJ45) and USB-A speed/version are not stated in the spec sheet, so no grade was set for either (grades should not be guessed). Not rack-mountable — this is a moving-head lighting fixture (22 kg, IP20, truss/floor mounted via omega adaptors), hence rackUnits omitted and category/type both fall outside the given AV-signal-chain taxonomy (mapped to "other"/"Other").
